_note: This tsconfig is intended to be typechecked transitively via the client (which imports from `compositions/*`) and the server (which bundles compositions at render-time). Running `npm run build` here in isolation will fail until you `npm install` inside this directory so react + remotion + their types are available. The root verify script does NOT typecheck compositions standalone; it relies on the client + server compile paths to catch type errors in shared types.
